title: ModelAdapterManifest
description: VENDORED from SourceOS-Linux/sourceos-spec (Tranche 7, canonical owner). Content-addressed store manifest for a LoRA (model) adapter in the Model Plane store (Tranche 7, T7-2). Sits at /var/lib/sourceos/models/adapters/sha256-<digest>/manifest.json. Named ModelAdapterManifest — NOT AdapterManifest — to avoid collision with AdapterDescriptor, which types connector/actuation adapters (api/cli/sdk), an unrelated sense of "adapter". A valid adapter manifest MUST declare the base-model digest it binds to (SEAM-017: rejected on mismatch) and MUST carry signature info (SEAM-017 signature verification). Referenced by AdapterPromotionDecision via candidateAdapterDigest / baseModelDigest.

specVersion.description: Spec version of this document, e.g. "2.1.0".

adapterDigest.description: Content address of the adapter weights — the directory key in the content-addressed store.

baseModelDigest.description: Digest of the base model this adapter binds to. Loading against a base whose digest differs is rejected (SEAM-017).

baseModelManifestRef.description: Optional URN of the ModelManifest for the base model; its modelDigest must equal baseModelDigest.

task.description: Task the adapter specializes, e.g. summarization, translation-de-en, agent_classification.

targetModules.description: Attention/MLP submodules the adapter targets, e.g. q_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj. Required and non-empty — an adapter that does not declare its target modules is not applicable by a consumer.

tokenizerDigest.description: Tokenizer digest if the adapter changes tokenization; null to inherit the base model's tokenizer.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the adapter weights (e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT). Required so the MIT/Apache-only rule is checkable; a distilled adapter also inherits any base-model license constraint.

signature.description: Detached-signature descriptor. Required — no adapter loads without signature verification (SEAM-017).

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm, e.g. ed25519, ecdsa-p256, rsa-pss-sha256.

keyId.description: Trust-store key identifier that must verify this signature.

signatureDigest.description: Digest of the detached signature blob stored beside the manifest.

evalReportDigest.description: Content-addressed digest of the eval report produced at training time; referenced by the AdapterPromotionDecision that promotes this adapter.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence URNs or content hashes for training provenance, contributing override events, and eval.
